title: The First Seed in Orbit
description: On Seed Day, the greenhouse crew trades seeds and gives the first squash sprout a drink. The water hangs in beads above its leaves.
alt: A gardener reaches toward a floating squash seedling as water beads drift from a silver can. Two gardeners trade seed packets, and a blue planet fills the view beyond the greenhouse.
pairing: An imagined orbital planting holiday × a floating squash seedling
